**Prerequisites:** Power Circuits Questions 1-6 complete, teacher approval, and printer availability.

Use the teacher-approved workflow to print an approved PCSS logo model, if your teacher provides one, or another small teacher-approved object. You do not need to design a new model.

## Safe workflow

1. Obtain the printer login from your teacher.
2. Select the approved printer and model.
3. Confirm scale, orientation, material, and estimated print time.
4. Show the sliced preview to the teacher and obtain approval.
5. Start the print and observe the first layer.
6. Stop and notify the teacher for poor adhesion, filament problems, unusual noise, collision, smoke, smell, or unexpected movement.
7. Let the printer and print surface cool, remove the object only when approved, and clean the area.

## Evidence

Submit the sliced-preview screenshot, first-layers photo, completed or safely stopped print photo, one statement about what worked, and one improvement for next time.

::: {.callout-note title="Success"}
A failed print can still earn achievement when the pair documents the evidence and responds safely.
:::
